title: Three Clues to a Song, a Show or a Publisher: Oshi no Ko
description: Ten rounds of three progressive clues: each one leads to a song, a season, a show inside the story, a company or a group. Light spoilers up to season two.
notes: Clues format: three clues of growing help, for works, companies and songs rather than for characters.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Oshi no Ko characters

questions.question: Which theme song is this?
clues: A theme song of the anime
It was first heard in spring 2023
It opens the first season

questions.question: Which season of the anime is this?
clues: A season of the anime
It aired in 2024
Its opening song is Fatal.

questions.question: Which company is this?
clues: A publisher that licensed the series for an English edition
It releases the Oshi no Ko manga in North America
Its name starts with the unit of Japanese money

questions.question: Which company is this?
clues: A business in the entertainment world of the story
Ichigo Saitō is its president, and his wife Miyako runs it
It is where Ai Hoshino was signed as a young idol

questions.question: Which show inside the story is this?
clues: A reality show that the characters take part in
Akane Kurokawa and Mem-cho are among its entrants
Its short name blends the words love and now

questions.question: Which screen project is this?
clues: A live-action project
It is a feature film that follows a live-action TV series
It reached the public in December 2024

questions.question: Which ending song is this?
clues: A theme song of the anime
It closes a season rather than opening it
It was used in the second season, in 2024

questions.question: Which manga is this?
clues: It comes from the same story writer as Oshi no Ko
It was still running in Weekly Young Jump when Oshi no Ko began there
Its writer also worked on a live-action film of it

questions.question: Which story inside the story is this?
clues: A manga that is turned into a stage play
Its artist is Abiko Samejima, who becomes a producer
Taiki Himekawa is the main star of the play

questions.question: Which group is this?
clues: An idol group in the story
Ai Hoshino was its centerpiece
Ruby forms a new version of it with Kana and Mem-cho
